teaser: A wedding toast microphone finds its way into your hand more often than seems fair. Life path 9 is the number of the Humanitarian, built around compassion for people in general and the slow work of letting go. ENFJ is the type that notices exactly which person at a long table needs noticing, and spends the evening making sure they feel seen. Crossed together, the ache is specific: a wide love for humanity sitting next to a talent for one close rescue at a time, and the question of which one gets fed on any given night.
excerpt: 'I didn't marry everyone, just you,' a partner says once, half joking, on a museum bench between wings, after watching you spend the whole visit in conversation with strangers waiting for the next tour.
